name: EPIC 212462805

text.card: A red giant 3,081 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.78 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,069 K at its surface.
